# OpenCode Workbench

> A reproducible, self-documenting, and recoverable OpenCode development workstation — configuration, agent skills, MCP stack, and an MCP server that provisions the entire setup onto any Linux machine (locally or over SSH).

Live site: https://opencode-workbench.simonmak.com
Remote MCP: https://opencode-workbench.simonmak.com/mcp
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench
MCP Registry: io.github.simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench
Repository: https://github.com/simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench

## Author
